sentences.en: Hello and welcome
sentences.zh: 你好，欢迎光临。

sentences.en: My name's Heather: McCallum and I'm one of the potters who work here at Edelman Pottery
sentences.zh: 我叫希瑟·麦卡勒姆，是埃德曼陶艺工作室的陶艺师之一。

sentences.en: Before we go into the workshop, I just want to say a bit about the craft of pottery
sentences.zh: 在进入工坊之前，我想先简单介绍一下陶艺这门工艺。

sentences.en: Then we'll have a look at the equipment and you can try making a pot of your own
sentences.zh: 接着我们会参观一下设备，你们还可以亲自尝试制作一个陶器。

sentences.en: Like man: y people, I'm sure you know that pottery as an art form is tens of thousands of years old
sentences.zh: 和许多人一样，我相信你们一定知道，陶艺作为一种艺术形式已有数万年历史。

sentences.en: And we know this because it stands the test of time
sentences.zh: 我们之所以知道这一点，是因为它经受住了时间的考验。

sentences.en: Things like baskets and pictures don't survive on the earth in the same way that pots do. and even if ancient pots are found in small pieces they still provide a lot of information about the past
sentences.zh: 像篮子和绘画这类物品无法像陶器那样在地球上长久保存；即便古代陶器仅以碎片形式被发现，它们仍能为我们提供大量关于过去的信息。

sentences.en: There no doubt that pottery has given archaeologists a fascinating insight into how ancient hills lived The shape of an artefact may have been lost but archaeologists can tell whether the pots were for, say, storage or cooking by examining the impressions on the clay, the scratches from tools, and the clay itself can reveal where the pots came from
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，陶器为考古学家提供了深入了解古代人类生活方式的迷人视角。尽管某件器物的具体形状可能已不复存在，但考古学家仍可通过观察陶土上的印痕、工具留下的刮痕，以及陶土本身的成分，来判断这些陶器是用于储藏还是烹饪，甚至还能推断出陶器的产地。

sentences.en: When I ask people why they want to take a pottery class with me, they sometimes talk about these things
sentences.zh: 当我询问人们为何想跟我学习陶艺课程时，他们有时会谈到这些方面。

sentences.en: Like our ancestors, they hope that something they create will also last longer than they do, that their work, whether it is good or not, might say something about humanity man: y years after their death
sentences.zh: 正如我们的祖先一样，他们希望亲手创作的作品也能比自己存续得更久——无论作品优劣如何，都可能在自己去世多年后，向后人诉说关于人类文明的某些信息。

sentences.en: Of course, you will all have your own reasons for coming here
sentences.zh: 当然，你们每个人来这里都有各自的理由。

sentences.en: As far as I'm concerned, what I love most is the concentration you need to make a good pot
sentences.zh: 就我个人而言，我最喜爱的是制作优质陶器所需的那种专注力。

sentences.en: That focus takes you away from the stresses of everyday life
sentences.zh: 这种专注能让你暂时忘却日常生活的压力。

sentences.en: If you're elderly, it's also good exercise for hands and wrists and helps with arthritis
sentences.zh: 对老年人来说，陶艺还能锻炼手部和手腕，有助于缓解关节炎症状。

sentences.en: And of course, it's a fun activity for children because it's so messy
sentences.zh: 当然，对儿童而言，这同样是一项充满乐趣的活动，因为过程非常‘ messy ’（混乱）。

sentences.en: Here at Edelman Pottery, we show you some of the basic pottery techniques so that you can use these to create whatever you wish
sentences.zh: 在埃德曼陶艺工作室，我们会向你们展示一些基础陶艺技法，以便你们能运用这些技巧自由创作心仪的作品。

sentences.en: A gift for a friend, perhaps
sentences.zh: 比如，为朋友制作一份礼物。

sentences.en: Like nearly everyone who comes here, I'm sure this is the first time you will have tried the art so we'll keep things simple today
sentences.zh: 我相信，和几乎所有来这里的学员一样，今天将是你们首次尝试陶艺，因此我们今天的课程内容将保持简单易懂。

sentences.en: Now, before we move on, can I just say a word about what you're wearing?
sentences.zh: 现在，在我们继续之前，能否请各位注意一下自己的着装？

sentences.en: As we said in our email please remove any watches, necklaces etc and put them somewhere safe
sentences.zh: 正如我们在电子邮件中所提醒的，请摘下所有手表、项链等饰品，并将其妥善存放。

sentences.en: If you have long hair do tie it back now
sentences.zh: 如果你留长发，请现在就把它扎起来。

sentences.en: We provide aprons later but I trust your clothes are old but comfortable, not your favourite T-shirt or jeans
sentences.zh: 稍后我们会提供围裙，但我相信你们穿的衣服是旧的但舒适的，而不是你们最喜欢的T恤或牛仔裤。

sentences.en: So now we're in the workshop
sentences.zh: 现在我们来到了车间。

sentences.en: Have a look around
sentences.zh: 请四处看看。

sentences.en: There's a lot going on
sentences.zh: 这里有很多事情正在进行。

sentences.en: To make pottery that will last, you need a potter's wheel, a kiln, which is basically a very hot oven where you fire the pottery, and some tools
sentences.zh: 要制作经久耐用的陶器，你需要一台拉坯机、一座窑炉（本质上是一种温度极高的烤箱，用于烧制陶器）以及一些工具。

sentences.en: So, first, the kiln
sentences.zh: 那么，首先来看窑炉。

sentences.en: If you look over in the far corner, you'll see one of ours
sentences.zh: 如果你们朝远处角落看去，就能看到我们的一座窑炉。

sentences.en: Since their invention, kilns have changed very little, though in the past 20 years a lot of progress has been made in temperature control
sentences.zh: 自发明以来，窑炉本身变化不大，不过在过去20年里，温度控制方面取得了很大进展。

sentences.en: Basically, a kiln removes the water from clay at temperatures of around 1000 degrees Celsius
sentences.zh: 基本上，窑炉在约1000摄氏度的高温下将黏土中的水分彻底去除。

sentences.en: This allows anything you've made to set permanently in shape
sentences.zh: 这使得你们所制作的任何物品都能永久定型。

sentences.en: It's a pretty ugly heavy object that's hard to keep in a house or flat, so most people don't have one
sentences.zh: 它是一个相当笨重丑陋的物件，很难安置在家或公寓里，因此大多数人家里都没有。

sentences.en: You may think, can't I use my oven?
sentences.zh: 你们或许会想：‘我能不能用自家烤箱呢？’

sentences.en: Well, that's possible, but domestic ovens don't really get hot enough and eventually the clay will crack and fall apart
sentences.zh: 嗯，理论上可行，但家用烤箱根本达不到所需高温，最终黏土会开裂并散架。

sentences.en: Some people fire pottery in a fire pit outside but bear in mind… that can be dangerous
sentences.zh: 有些人会在室外的火坑中烧制陶器，但请务必注意……这可能很危险。

sentences.en: You also need to know about safety procedures for kilns as they release toxic compounds into the air
sentences.zh: 你们还需了解窑炉的安全操作规程，因为窑炉会向空气中释放有毒化合物。

sentences.en: Every potter needs a potter's wheel
sentences.zh: 每位陶艺师都需要一台拉坯机。

sentences.en: This machine is used to shape the clay into an object with circular walls or sides, such as a bowl
sentences.zh: 这种机器用于将黏土塑造成具有圆形壁或侧边的器物，例如碗。

sentences.en: Its invention revolutionised the pottery industry, allowing multiple items to be produced in a day
sentences.zh: 它的发明彻底改变了陶器行业，使人们每天能批量生产多种器物。

sentences.en: Lastly, there are a number of different tools that potters use, depending on what they want to make
sentences.zh: 最后，陶艺师还会使用多种不同工具，具体取决于他们想要制作的器物。

sentences.en: When you start, your hands can make all kinds of shapes and curves without relying on a sculpting tool
sentences.zh: 刚开始时，你的双手可以做出各种形状和曲线，而无需依赖雕塑工具。

sentences.en: However, there are some basic tools that you will need to handle the clay on the wheel
sentences.zh: 然而，有一些基本工具是你在拉坯机上处理陶土时必需的。

sentences.en: Some look very strange and have even odder names that you may find hard to remember
sentences.zh: 有些工具看起来非常奇怪，甚至有着更奇怪的名字，你可能会觉得很难记住。

sentences.en: Rather than go through them all now, I'll just name a few tools as we go along
sentences.zh: 与其现在一一介绍所有工具，不如我们在操作过程中逐一提及几种。

sentences.en: We can provide these and I wouldn't recommend spending money on them yet
sentences.zh: 我们可以提供这些工具，而且我目前不建议你们花钱购买。

sentences.en: So, let's try making a pot of your own
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们来尝试自己制作一个陶罐吧。

sentences.en: If you sit down
sentences.zh: 如果你坐下来……
